messages:
maia_ap: Flagging INV-9075 from Spectra Logic. Invoice shows PO: none and lists VAT ID DE999888. Our vendor master has Spectra Logic as US entity (no VAT). System routed to AP hold for vendor mismatch.
nate_procure: We onboarded Spectra US (Acct 01234) last quarter, but they sometimes bill from their EU branch. Do we have EU vendor record?
toni_tax: If they're billing from DE entity we need a separate vendor account and VAT validation. Ask vendor to confirm billing entity and provide VAT docs.
vendor-bot: Spectra Logic (billing@spectralogic.eu) uploaded INV-9075 (PDF) link: https://files.example.com/spectra/INV-9075.pdf
maia_ap: Invoice total 
2,350.00 EUR. AP can't match without vendor account. Placing payment_hold:true.
finance-bot: Automation: route set to procurement for vendor validation. Task T-4507 created.
nate_procure: Reached out: vendor replied they billed from EU branch (Spectra Logic GmbH). They confirmed VAT DE999888 and request payment to IBAN DE44... No PO because services were ad-hoc.
toni_tax: VAT valid. Procurement, please create vendor account Spectra Logic GmbH and add alias linking to US parent. Also create post-facto PO or allow invoice-only payment per policy for small value (<5k).
nate_procure: Created vendor acct 04567 (Spectra Logic GmbH) and added alias. Opting for invoice-only approval to speed payment. Added note: "vendor VAT verified 2026-02-11".
maia_ap: Re-ran match; invoice linked to acct 04567. Coding to GL 6104 (software services).
leo_payments: Treasury: use FX rate 1.081 on invoice date. Converted USD 2,540.35. Removing hold and scheduling EMEA run.
maia_ap: Approved. Closing thread.
